title: Bind the remote host to localhost by default and compare tokens in constant time
notes:
remote-host.ts:30 binds every interface over plain ws. A joined screen reaches pty:input and task:run. Bind 127.0.0.1 by default, make network a setting with wss, use timingSafeEqual. Cost small to medium. (docs/review/2026-11-01.md S1)

Shipped in #173: the remote host listens on 127.0.0.1 unless host.bind in settings.json names another interface (hand-written only, documented in docs/remote-host/README.md and remote-host-decision-3); tokens compared with timingSafeEqual after a byte-length check. Not done: wss:// for a network bind (needs a certificate design).
